data.title: Add import/export functionality
data.body:
## Goal

Enable importing bugs from and exporting bugs to external systems.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] `docket export ID --format json` exports bug as JSON
- [ ] `docket export ID --format markdown` exports as markdown
- [ ] `docket export --all --format json` exports all bugs
- [ ] `docket import FILE.json` imports bug(s) from JSON
- [ ] `docket import github --repo OWNER/REPO --issue NUMBER` imports GitHub issue
- [ ] Imported bugs start in Draft status
- [ ] Preserve original metadata where possible (created date, etc.)

## Context

Docket doesn't need to replace GitHub Issues entirely. Being able to import issues for local work and potentially sync back would make it more practical for teams.

Lower priority: most users will create bugs directly in docket.
